content: Is Suat te Sevaha he Etew he Mekeuvey ziyà te Etuvangan te Nengazen

content.text: Is kebpenginahanglan ku kenikew te Megbevayè ku,
iring te kebpenginahanglan te selazeng te wahig emun egkemezahan sikandin.
Egkemezahan a kenikew he iyan uuyag he Megbevayà.
Keenu e pa vuwa ebpekehendiyà te valey nu te ked-uvey ziyà te etuvangan nu?
Maandew wey mezukilem is kebpekesineǥew ku ne samè dà kenè ku meinum is luhè ku, ne zutun edtulung ed-insà is menge etew te,
“Hendei en be is Megbevayè nu he edtavang kenikew?”
Kenà meupiya is isip ku emun egketenuzan ku he zutun te nehuna he timpu iyan a nengulu te mezakel he menge etew te kedhendiyà te valey nu.
Ne edsilibra key zuma is ked-ugyab te kegkelipey wey kebpeselamat kenikew.
Piru kenà a ereg he egkeseeng wey egkeǥiyaǥiya.
Ereg a he edsarig kenikew. Uya, ed-umanan ku sikew edeliǥa, is menluluwas wey Megbevayè ku.
Utew a neseeng; is kegkeseeng ku iring te edeǥurus he seleg te evaǥa he ebpeketambun kediey.
Umbe edtentenuzan ku sikew ǥuntaan te kayi a te tanà he uvey te Jordan wey Hermon, kayi te Buntud he Mizar.
Emun maandew ibpeehè nu is gaǥew nu Nengazen,
umbe emun mezukilem en, egkanta a te ked-ampù diyà te kenikew te Megbevayà he mibeǥey kedì te untung ku.
He Megbevayà he endilungè ku, egkaǥi a ziyà te kenikew te,
“Maan is edlipatan a kenikew?
Maan is kinahanglan pa he egkeseeng a tenged te kedèdaaǥa kedì te menge kuntada ku?”
Henduen be te nerupet en is menge tulan ku tenged te kebpeel-elezi zan kedì.
Egkeǥiyan e zan te, “Hendei en be is Megbevayè nu he edtavang kenikew?”
Maan is egkeseeng a wey egkeǥiyaǥiya?
Te ereg e man he edsarig kenikew,
ne ed-umanan ku sikew edeliǥa is menluluwas ku he Megbevayè ku.
